title: Integral Curves and Flows on Banach Manifolds in Lean
summary: We present a formalisation of the existence and uniqueness theorems of integral curves of vector fields on Banach manifolds in the Lean theorem prover. First, we formalize properties of differential equations on Banach spaces (the Picard-Lindelöf theorem, the Grönwall inequality, and corollaries), and then transfer results to abstract Banach manifolds.
